name: model-router
description: Smart model router: classifies each prompt and runs it on a fitting model and effort, with a Router log tab and a manual model/effort picker.

classifier.title: Classifier
classifier.description: Who classifies prompts: haiku (alias, latest Haiku), claude-haiku-5-5 (pinned Haiku), jev (TypeSafe Jev), or openai / simple (your own endpoint, set the URL below).

externalUrl.title: External classifier URL
externalUrl.description: Endpoint for jev (empty uses https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone) or for the openai / simple classifiers.

externalModel.title: External classifier model
externalModel.description: Model name sent to the external service (jev default jev-latest; openai format).

externalApiKey.title: External classifier API key
externalApiKey.description: Sent as a Bearer token to the external endpoint. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

externalMinConfidence.title: Jev minimum confidence
externalMinConfidence.description: With format jev, an answer below this confidence (0-1) is not trusted and the Claude classifier decides instead. 0 trusts every answer.
